topic: processed food, healthy eating, and exercise recovery
conversation_summary: Hugh discussed his approach to healthy eating in the context of regular training. He mentioned training in Thailand for 3 months, eating bitter melon stir-fried with little oil, craving meat and vegetables after exercise, and cooking at home — with the exception of when he lived in Vietnam. Good natural fluency throughout with minor corrections on vẫn vs còn, gà xé vs gà xé phay, and duy trì nhịp tim bình thường vs giữ nhịp tim ổn định.
correction_notes: 1. gầy (spelling — not gây). 2. không chỉ (tone mark — not không chi). 3. sức lực vs nỗ lực — Hugh self-corrected. 4. gà xé → gà xé phay/gà xé nhỏ. 5. duy trì nhịp tim bình thường → giữ nhịp tim ổn định (more natural). 6. khi tôi vẫn ở Việt Nam → khi tôi còn ở Việt Nam (vẫn = still ongoing; còn = still but no longer the case).
